summary: Pre-launch frontend smoke test on MyCareerCopilot. Logged in as refactor_test@example.com via /auth and verified all major pages render without crashes. Landing, Dashboard, Profile, Applications, Saved Jobs, Job Search, Career Paths (with Guidance Triplet), Career Coach, Interview Prep, Billing, and Pricing all load successfully (HTTP 200, no React/console errors). Career Paths guidance triplet works: all three data-testids (guidance-section-skills-0, guidance-section-plan-0, guidance-section-ask-0) are present, clickable, and reveal Skill Gap Checklist, 30-Day Game Plan and cached 'Ask the Coach' Q/A content. Logout via avatar menu works and protected routes correctly redirect to landing after sign-out. Navigation (Dashboard/Find Jobs/Applications/Interview Prep/Career Paths/Profile/Support/Home + avatar menu) all functional.

integration_issues.issue: Could NOT verify the 'What to Do Next' / NextStepsCard inline panel because the test user (refactor_test@example.com) has ZERO applications. /api/applications returned {"applications":[]} so the UI correctly shows the 'No Applications Yet' empty state. The review request stated ~5+ applications expected for this user; this is a SEED DATA mismatch, not a frontend bug. Main agent must either (a) re-seed applications for refactor_test or (b) provide a different test user that already has Applied status records before NextStepsCard can be validated.

critical_code_review_comments: All page-level routes in App.js are wrapped in ProtectedRoute and correctly redirect to '/' when unauthenticated - verified by post-logout navigation to /dashboard.
Pre-launch Stripe bypass is working: Billing page loads without paywalls/upgrade modals for the regular user.
Career Paths Guidance Triplet (PathGuidance.jsx) renders cached AI content correctly with proper expand/collapse and stable data-testids.
Coach route automatically redirects /coach -> /coach/{conversation_id} which is intended behavior.
